title: Extended finite direct D and modular derivative across path exhaustion and beta
question: On finite actual-Q3 Gibbs members along a path4/path6 exhaustion pair, do direct two-orientation D and modular derivative delta-D norms remain bounded uniformly over the declared coordinate cutoffs, times and beta values?

model.cutoff: replace every bond coordinate q by the smooth cosine spectral cutoff q_L; W_L=H-H_L
model.modular_difference: delta D_sigma=[-beta H,D_sigma] in the finite Gibbs representation
model.shape: path4 is lifted by identities on sites 4,5 when compared with path6; this is a structured exhaustion diagnostic, not arbitrary-shape uniformity

adversarial_review.check: Each beta row uses the uncut finite-H Gibbs state for its own volume; no local Gibbs replacement is made.
H+W_L and H-W_L are evolved separately for both time signs in both lanes.
delta-D is the explicit finite commutator with -beta H and is not inferred from D alone.
Radii 0.5 and 1.0 retain nonzero tails while radius 2.0 is checked as a zero-tail control.
Path4/path6 is only a structured finite pair; its beta- and volume-dependent values are reported rather than promoted to a uniform theorem.
The independent lane reconstructs oscillator, Hamiltonian, cutoff and Gibbs seminorm without importing the primary module.
Hermiticity, finite values, t=0 anchoring and both-lane agreement are asserted with explicit tolerances.
Uniform direct D/delta-D, common core, exhaustion, common alpha, OS/KMS/GNS, gap, continuum, C6, Sector A and Pre-A remain open.
Lean R267 is reused for rational direct-bound and zero-tail bookkeeping only; dense matrices remain Python evidence.

lean_crosscheck.role: R267 checks rational direct-bound, orientation and zero-tail fixtures; Python checks all matrix rows.

qft_interface.closed: Finite direct D and delta-D rows for both orientations over the path4/path6 pair, three beta values, two times and three coordinate radii.
qft_interface.open: The finite maxima are diagnostics only; volume-, source-, cutoff- and beta-uniform Cauchy, product/core density, exhaustion interchange, common alpha and all QFT reconstruction gates remain open.
qft_interface.tect_boundary: Auxiliary C6/Q3 evidence only; no heat_root_incidence, canonical A1/R-192 production owner, physical-empty reference or Sector-A closure is supplied.

next_action: Use the measured volume/beta dependence to select a genuinely local or modular common-core norm; if a uniform coefficient cannot be derived analytically, record that obstruction before common-alpha promotion.
boundary: T0 claim-nonbearing finite Gibbs diagnostic on d=3 path4/path6 matrices. It is not an exhaustion-independent thermodynamic D,delta-D theorem or a QFT/Clay result.
no_overclaim: This package does not prove any volume-, source-, cutoff- or beta-uniform direct D/delta-D Cauchy estimate, common unbounded core, exhaustion independence, common alpha, OS/KMS/GNS identification, gap, continuum, C6, Sector A or Pre-A.
